title: HOW SEVEN MUMBAI WOMEN TURNED RS 80 INTO A PAPAD COOPERATIVE WORTH MILLIONS

title: HOW AMUL'S FARMER-POOLED CO-OP TURNED MILK INTO A RS 1 LAKH CRORE BRAND

title: IPO-bound Aragen plans to spend Rs 15 billion over 3 years for expansion, MD says
text: Aragen Life Sciences will invest approximately 15 billion rupees over three years for its expansion. This investment aims to enhance capacity in drug development and manufacturing, including small molecules and biologics. The company's stock market debut includes a fresh issue of 8 billion rupees and an offer for sale of shares. Aragen's current revenue largely comes from drug discovery services, with expectations of future growth.
